At BAT we are proud to be a global leader in sustainability.
But don’t take our word for it.
For the 19th consecutive year, we have been included in the
Dow Jones Sustainability Indices (DJSI) – the gold standard
of tracking an organisation’s environmental, social and
governance practices.
We are the only company in our industry to feature in the DJSI
World Index; the top 10% of global ESG leaders.
This recognition inspires us to keep accelerating towards
building A Better Tomorrow™.
*BAT Group
